settings.heading: Get in touch
settings.text: Questions about photos, styles or your commission? The studio is happy to help.

settings.question: Is the art made with AI?
settings.answer: No. Every piece is drawn by a human artist, stroke by stroke, and we never use AI image generation. Want proof? Ask for the work-in-progress sketches of your commission and we'll happily share them.

settings.question: What photos work best?
settings.answer: Three to five clear, well-lit photos taken at your pet's eye level. A front-facing shot plus a couple of personality shots is perfect, and phone photos are absolutely fine.

settings.question: How long does my art take?
settings.answer: Your finished files arrive by email within 3 to 5 days of sending your photos. Need it faster for a gift? Get in touch and we'll try to squeeze you in.

settings.question: How do I use my stickers on WhatsApp?
settings.answer: Every pack comes with a simple step-by-step guide for WhatsApp, Telegram and iMessage. It takes about two minutes to install.

settings.question: Can I get changes made?
settings.answer: Yes! One free revision round is included with every commission. We want it perfect as much as you do.

settings.question: Do you ship anything?
settings.answer: Nope. PawsPal is 100% digital, so every product arrives by email with no shipping cost, no customs and no waiting at the door.
